summary: RedHill Biopharma Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing that the FDA granted Rare Pediatric Disease (RPD) designation to opaganib for neuroblastoma, adding to existing Orphan Drug Designation. No M&A, tender, restructuring, or capital returns event. The filing is a routine regulatory update regarding a drug development milestone. No transaction terms, board recommendation, or advisors mentioned. The event is purely clinical/regulatory; there are no deal mechanics, closing conditions, or risk-arb angles. Accordingly, this is not a special-situation filing.
